'''Peex Curando''' was a [[Selkath]] [[dockmaster]] and [[passenger service agent]] who worked in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].

==Biography==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Year">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Peex Curando became a [[dockmaster]] and [[passenger service agent]]<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]]'s [[spaceport]] hallway<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=day-trivia-gallery-the-acolyte|text="Day" Trivia Gallery | The Acolyte}} {{C|Slide 7}}</ref> on the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[capital]] [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Lost/FoundAD">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Peex Curando was a Selkath with [[Color|yellow]] [[eye]]s and [[Color|blue]] and light skin.<ref name="Lost/Found" /> As a dockmaster and passenger service agent, Curando fielded questions about departure and arrival times and gates. Their tireless work ethic logged 18 [[Standard hour|hour]] shifts.<ref name="Guide" />

==Equipment==
The Selkath wore an [[atmospheric mister]] concealed under their tan [[Clothing|tunic]]. Curando also wore brown shoes with their toes exposed.<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Peex Curando first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'',<ref name="Lost/Found" /> which aired on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Lost/FoundRelease">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> [[Martin Rezard]] worked on the prosthetics for Curando.<ref name="RezardEmail">{{EmailCite|email=File:MartinRezard-AcolyteEmail.png|creator=Martin Rezard|date=2025-10-05}}</ref>
